_note: AUTHORED, not recorded from the live server. ClickUp's official MCP server's real tool names and response shapes are NEEDS VERIFICATION (docs/architecture/mcp-connectors.md); a web search found only third-party servers' names. This file pins the name the kernel's definition (kernel/src/integrations/mcp/trackers.ts) uses and the argument names the ClickUp source sends (list_ids or space_ids, statuses, assignees, tags). The owner's live ClickUp run (phase 8 item 13) confirms or corrects both. The kernel refuses a name the connection's own tool list lacks (tool_unavailable), so a wrong guess is a named failure, never a call to an unknown tool.
